text:
In garden’s hush, the wild winds sigh,
Beneath the watchful, leafy sky.
The blossoms bloom, a silent vow,
To show the beauty hidden now.

The ancient trees, in stillness stand,
With rustling leaves across the land.
They guard the secrets of the years,
And whisper truths through passing tears.

Here solace finds the weary heart,
In nature’s gentle, steady art.
For every leaf that falls and dies,
Reflects the truth of time’s long rise.

The animal with distinctive black and white stripes is the zebra.
